topic: Gaming/reaction skit: stars (Messi, Ronaldo, Neymar, Mbappe per title) judge parody EA FC 27 cover designs while a free-kick is taken in a football game
hero: Free-kick taker in blue-red kit and reactor face-cams (title names Messi, Ronaldo, Neymar, Mbappe)
hook: Fake PS5 'FC27' cover with youngster in yellow jersey on left, free-kick on pitch, reactor face-cam top-right
subtitle_style: none; small distance label '21 Yds'/'22 Yds' top-centre from game HUD
reaction_overlays: Left-side fake PS5 EA FC27 game case changes per round (princess-dress couple, striped-shirt trio, man in white coat); rotating face-cams with headphones top-right
transition_summary: Fixed layout; cover image and face-cam swap every few seconds as the free-kick repeats (1 detected scene cut)
audio_note: Reaction voices in face-cams, likely synthetic; transcript: 'Can the goat create better FC 27 covers than the rigor? Let's find out'

reuse_segments.what: Game free-kick footage with fake covers and face-cam overlays
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: recreate with own game capture and generated/licensed face-cam; avoid real likenesses
